pages.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This exact supplied image is a technical RPG Maker pixel-art tileset atlas page, not a landscape. Original 256-pixel-wide strips are packed side by side on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Refine ONLY very subtle fine material grain inside existing ground, foliage, rocks, walls, roofs, wood and metal. Preserve original colors, pixel-art shapes, object positions and sizes, every outline, all tile boundaries, object count/orientation, all existing text and symbols, and every blank/transparent region. Keep every item at precisely its original coordinates. Do not rearrange, add, remove or merge anything. No new buildings, lettering, shadows, lights, decorations, frames or watermark. Do not combine the atlas items into a scene. No crop, zoom or padding change. Output target 1536x1024 exact 3:2 aspect ratio. Original transparency must remain transparent. This is a conservative texture-detail proposal; original structure has priority.
